brief: Using only the files under docs/ in this repository, answer: what is the first version of streamio that users could install and call Client.stream() in; the first version in which Client.stream() accepts a timeout argument; and the first version that has that timeout and is affected by no security advisory in docs/security/? Write RESEARCH.json in the repository root with the keys "stream_since", "timeout_since" and "safe_since" (version numbers such as "1.0.0") and "sources" (the paths of the files that settle each answer).
